# Approved conformance provenance

This directory contains the small set of source evidence required to validate
the immutable approved expectation bundles. These files are retained because
the promotion loader verifies their hashes; they are not live provider data or
production observations.

- `phase2i5/` contains the source facts and analyst worksheets bound by the
  approved OpenAQ and PurpleAir bundles.
- `philippines_denr/` contains the independent candidate, synthetic candidate,
  approved review package, and approval record bound by the Philippines bundle.

Generated review reports, working packages, screenshots, and smoke-test
scripts are intentionally excluded from this permanent provenance directory.
